findings.location: source.html — multiple <em> Scripture quotations (James 1:5, Psalm 103:2-3, James 5:16, James 2:15-16, 1 Corinthians 12:26, Philippians 1:21)
findings.source_quote:
If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him –James 1:5. ... Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases –Psalm 103:2-3. ... …The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much –James 5:16. ...

If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food, And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit? –James 2:15-16.

... …اشتكى عضو اشتكى معه سائر الأعضاء… –1 Corinthians 12:26. ... For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain –Philippians 1:21.

, etc.) unchanged. (render the verse in Arabic S. Standard phrasing preserving citation). - Replace the Psalm quote with an Arabic rendering: «بارك يا نفسي الرب، ولا تنس كل مزاياه: الذي يغفر كل آثامك، الذي يشفي كل أمراضك» – مزمور 103:2-3. - Replace James 5:16, James 2:15-16, 1 Corinthians 12:26, Philippians 1:21 with appropriate Arabic translations of those quoted lines, preserving punctuation and the original citation placement. (Do not change tags, do not alter verse numbers or their placement; only replace the English quoted text with faithful Arabic translations.)

findings.source_quote: Many of the things that increase the risk of cancer are things that (hopefully) we, as Christian people, are already avoiding.
findings.suggested_fix: The translation rendered this as: "العديد من الأشياء التي تزيد من خطر الإصابة بالسرطان هي أمور نتجنّبها نحن، كمسيحيين، على أمل أن نكون بالفعل نتجنبها." This duplicates 'نتجنبها' and reads awkwardly. Suggest: "العديد من الأشياء التي تزيد من خطر الإصابة بالسرطان هي أمور نتجنّبها نحن كمسيحيين، على أمل أننا نفعل ذلك بالفعل." Keep HTML unchanged.

findings.source_quote: "a normal white cell count is between 4,000 and 10,000. but during cancer treatments I have seen patient’s white cell count drop down to 200."
findings.suggested_fix: In the translation this became two sentences with a lowercase 'but' in English fragment context previously. Ensure Arabic punctuation and sentence casing are correct. For instance: "قد يكون عدد الخلايا البيضاء الطبيعي بين 4,000 و10,000، لكن أثناء علاجات السرطان رأيت أعدادًا تنخفض إلى 200." Preserve numerical values and HTML.
